1. Acceptance & Modification

This User Service Agreement ("Agreement") is between you ("User") and Xia Weibing, developer of the ShrimpFarm app, regarding the use of this application.

Please read this Agreement carefully before downloading or using the app. If you do not agree, do not use the app. By using the app, you agree to be bound by this Agreement.

The developer may revise this Agreement when necessary. Changes will be posted in the app. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

2. Services

This app is an Android management tool for shrimp farmers, providing: basic data management, batch management, feeding records, water quality management, pond inspection, feed mixing calculation, data analysis, backup, market prices, and scheduled tasks.

Services are for reference only and do not constitute farming advice or investment decisions.

3. Account Registration & Management

You need a valid email to register for cloud features (backup, market prices). You are responsible for keeping your account credentials secure.

You can delete your account via the app. After deletion, server-side user info is removed. Local data is not automatically deleted.

4. User Conduct

You agree to: comply with applicable laws, not reverse-engineer the app, not interfere with its operation, and not use it for illegal purposes.

5. Data Backup & Restore

The app supports local backup (Downloads folder, up to 20 copies) and WebDAV backup to Jianguoyun. Auto-backup runs when conditions are met.

WebDAV backup depends on third-party service (Jianguoyun). The developer is not responsible for service interruptions. We strongly recommend using local backup as a supplement.
